videos.title: Money Expert Explains How Anyone Can Get Rich Off Their 9-5 | Codie Sanchez
videos.description:
Hard work doesn't make you wealthy. If it did, the person running your local laundromat would out-earn Jeff Bezos.

In this clip, Codie Sanchez and Jay Shetty talk about why owning a home might not be the smart financial move it used to be, and why you suffer less from a lack of money than a lack of knowing how to get it.

Codie breaks down the real difference between debit and credit cards, why "passive income" is mostly a myth, and the one mentality shift she calls it fixer vs. freeloader that decides who actually gets rich.

Learn about the lipstick theory that predicts a recession before the headlines do, and why the smartest thing you can do with your money right now might be nothing like what your parents did.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe
